sources.snippet: An advanced, high-performance Python command-line toolkit for using the Qwen-ASR API (formerly Qwen3-ASR-Flash). This implementation overcomes the API's 3-minute audio length limitation by intelligently splitting long audio/video files and processing them in parallel, enabling rapid transcription of hours-long content.
